descriptions.job-1ucm8tx:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast — both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

This role owns the operational engine of CX — the floor, the vendors, the schedule, and the systems that keep support running 24/7 without falling over. You'll take our small in-house "Agents Plus" team and build the operating model that lets it scale alongside our external BPO partners, then run both like one operation.

Volume in this business spikes hard around elections, major sports moments, and breaking news — your job is to make sure the org bends without breaking when it does. You're part operator, part vendor manager, part workforce planner: someone comfortable owning a P&L line with a BPO, reading a demand forecast and translating it into shifts and staffing, and treating coverage as a design problem, not a scheduling headache.

What You'll Do

  • Hire, manage, and develop our in-house Agents Plus team — the core crew that handles our highest-stakes and most sensitive interactions directly

  • Own the relationship with our outsourced support partner(s) end to end — sourcing, contracting, performance management, and the escalation path when a vendor underperforms

  • Forecast volume, build shift and coverage models across time zones, staff to demand, and manage schedule adherence and shrinkage so coverage holds at 3am on a Tuesday and during a live election night alike

  • Decide when to flex vendor headcount vs. in-house capacity, build surge playbooks for high-profile events, and make the build-vs-buy calls that keep the model efficient as volume grows

  • Own the operational metrics — SLAs, occupancy, shrinkage, cost-per-contact, response and resolution time — and keep the org honest to them

  • Spot operational friction — bad handoffs, coverage gaps, tooling that slows agents down — and fix it before it becomes a pattern

  • Partner tightly with the strategy side of CX; quality standards and process design only work if they hold up on the floor — you're the reality check and execution partner

  • Represent capacity, cost, and coverage trade-offs in planning conversations, and push back with data when a plan doesn't hold up operationally

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years in support operations, workforce management, or BPO/vendor management, including direct experience managing an outsourced or blended (in-house + vendor) support model

  • Hands-on experience running workforce management — forecasting, scheduling, real-time management, shrinkage and adherence — for a 24/7 or near-24/7 operation

  • A track record of directly owning a BPO relationship: contracting, SLAs, performance management, and escalation

  • Comfortable owning a budget or cost model for support operations and making build-vs-buy or vendor-vs-in-house calls

  • Tool-native and data-comfortable: dashboards, WFM software, ticketing and QA platforms — you don't need to write code, but you're fluent enough to make evidence-based staffing calls

  • Experience operating in a variable, spiky-volume environment — fintech, trading, gaming, marketplaces, or another event-driven consumer platform

  • Strong process discipline — you build the playbook once, then keep it current as volume and headcount change

  • Comfortable operating at the leadership level, communicating capacity, cost, and trade-offs clearly to non-operations stakeholders

  • (Plus) Experience scaling a small in-house team alongside an external BPO simultaneously

  • (Plus) Domain context in prediction markets, sportsbooks, trading, or another market where volume is event-driven and time-sensitive

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Equinox membership

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $300,000 to $400,000 annually, plus equity and benefits.

This range reflects a good-faith estimate for this position. Experience levels vary widely within a title here, so please reach out even if your expectations fall outside it. We're always happy to chat.

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

We are looking for a Director, Product Finance and FP&A to help drive Ramp’s next phase of growth! This role spans our Product Finance and Corporate FP&A functions. You'll own two of the highest-leverage areas on the team: the unit economics and monetization strategy across every product we ship, and the financial architecture of the company—model, budget, and Board reporting. The work you do will directly shape how we price, how we allocate capital, and how we support executive decision-making through financial insights and planning.

This represents a truly unique opportunity to join one of the country’s fastest-growing startups as we scale toward a potential IPO. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Accounting, and executive leadership to drive some of Ramp’s most important financial decisions.

What You’ll Do

Product Finance

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

About the Liquidity Platform

The Liquidity Platform provides technology covering the full lifecycle of cryptocurrency trading, including venue connectivity, real-time market data processing, automated quoting and trading, order execution, position management, risk controls, and data analytics. The platform connects to centralized exchanges, decentralized venues, and event contract markets worldwide. It supports spot, derivatives, and event contract products and provides stable, efficient infrastructure for our liquidity business. 
 

About the Options Market Making Team

The Options Market Making team develops and operates automated options quoting and trading systems. Our responsibilities span market data integration, options pricing, volatility and Greeks calculations, automated quoting, order execution, position management, hedging, and risk controls. The team owns the complete trading lifecycle and continues to advance both the multilingual development of our trading systems and our AI-native engineering practices. In this role, you will contribute across the trading system, develop an understanding of its different business domains, and take end-to-end responsibility from requirements analysis and implementation through production operation.
 
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, develop, and operate automated options market making systems covering market data, pricing, quoting, order execution, hedging, positions, and risk controls.
  • Work closely with trading, quantitative, and product teams to translate business requirements into reliable, testable production systems. 
  • Contribute to the development of trading systems and continuously improve the performance, stability, and maintainability of critical trading paths. 
  • Follow an AI-native engineering approach by applying AI coding tools to requirements analysis, technical design, development, testing, and code review, while remaining accountable for the quality of the final delivery. 
  • Improve testing, monitoring, alerting, and recovery capabilities, and participate in incident resolution and post-incident reviews. 
  • Own the technical design and code review of core modules. Senior and Staff engineers will also lead cross-module projects and architectural evolution.

What We Look For In You

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related discipline.
  • At least two years of experience in backend engineering, real-time systems, infrastructure, or trading systems.
  • Proficiency in at least one of Java, Rust, or C++, with the ability to work effectively in a multilingual codebase.
  • Strong computer science fundamentals, including operating systems, network communication, multithreading, concurrent programming, and distributed systems.
  • Proficiency in using AI coding tools for requirements analysis, development, testing, and code review, with the ability to independently evaluate and validate AI-generated designs and code.
  • Strong analytical skills, business understanding, ownership, and communication skills, including the ability to read technical materials and communicate in written English.

Technical Requirements

  • Proficiency in developing production systems with Java 17+, Rust, or C++, with the ability to design, implement, and troubleshoot within a multilingual codebase.
  • Familiarity with Linux development and runtime environments, including the use of common tools for resource analysis, performance diagnostics, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with multithreading, asynchronous processing, network I/O, and high-performance data structures, with an understanding of lock contention, memory allocation, caching, garbage collection, and their impact on latency.
  • Ability to use AI coding tools to support requirements analysis, development, testing, and code review, while independently validating the correctness and production safety of generated code.
  • Familiarity with TCP, UDP, WebSocket, HTTP, or proprietary exchange protocols, with experience developing real-time data or trading interfaces.
  • Ability to design and optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems and identify bottlenecks through profiling, benchmarking, and production metrics.
  • Familiarity with real-time messaging and inter-process communication. Experience with Aeron, shared memory, lock-free queues, or binary protocols is preferred.
  • Experience building logging, metrics, alerting, and automated recovery capabilities for continuously operating production systems.
  • Familiarity with build and dependency management for large multi-module projects, together with experience in unit testing, integration testing, and continuous integration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in options market making, quantitative trading, exchange connectivity, market data, order management, quoting, hedging, or risk systems.
  • Understanding of order books, order lifecycles, and market microstructure.
  • Understanding of options pricing, volatility, Greeks, PnL, inventory risk, and dynamic hedging.
  • Experience developing low-latency trading systems, real-time market data systems, or high-performance network services.
  • Experience evolving multilingual systems or separating performance-sensitive components.
  • Experience with market data replay, strategy simulation, trade reconciliation, or production incident resolution.
  • Experience using Python for data analysis, backtesting, or production diagnostics.
  • Practical experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex in production projects.
 

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances 
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!

About Cantina

Cantina Labs is a social AI company developing a suite of advanced video generation models. We bring characters to life, transforming how people tell stories, connect, and create. We build and power ecosystems. Cantina, our flagship social AI platform, is just the beginning.

About the Internship

Cantina is growing its research lab in Singapore, and we are looking for exceptional research interns to work with us on the next generation of video models in October 2026.

This is a three month onsite internship designed to give you meaningful ownership of a well-defined research or engineering problem. You will be matched with a project based on your background and interests, working closely with a senior mentor from initial problem formulation through experimentation, evaluation, and, where appropriate, submission to a leading AI conference.

Projects may focus on post-training and inference efficiency for video generation models, reward modeling and preference-based optimization multimodal data systems, or scalable infrastructure for video model training. The primary focus will be your core project, with opportunities to contribute to applied or product-adjacent work where relevant.

What You’ll Work On

Depending on your project, you may:

  • Research and develop distillation methods for large-scale diffusion and flow-based video generation models, including guidance and adversarial distillation

  • Explore techniques that reduce inference cost while preserving or improving generation quality

  • Develop reward models and preference-based optimization methods to improve aesthetics, motion quality, temporal consistency, and prompt adherence

  • Study how base-model behavior affects post-training outcomes and use experimental findings to inform model development

  • Design rigorous evaluations and conduct large-scale experiments on generative video models

  • Contribute to evaluation harnesses, model integrations, research tooling, or other product-adjacent projects related to your core work

  • Document and communicate your findings through research reports, internal presentations, demonstrations, and potential conference submissions

You may be a good fit if you

  • Are currently pursuing a PhD or are a final-year master’s student in computer science, machine learning, computer vision, or a related field

  • Have research experience in generative modeling, computer vision, multimodal learning, or video generation

  • Have hands on experience with diffusion models, flow-based models, model distillation, reinforcement learning, preference optimization, or related post-training techniques

  • Can formulate hypotheses, design controlled experiments, analyze results, and communicate conclusions clearly

  • Are proficient in Python and have hands-on experience with PyTorch, JAX, or another modern machine learning framework

  • Are comfortable working independently on an open-ended research problem while collaborating closely with a mentor and the broader team

Experience with video, image, audio, or other multimodal data is valuable. Publications at leading venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, or AAAI are a plus, but are not required. We care most about the quality of your thinking, the depth of your technical work, and your ability to learn quickly.

What You Can Expect

  • A defined project and named senior mentor before your first day

  • Weekly one-on-one meetings and clear project milestones

  • A meaningful compute allocation for your research

  • The opportunity to own a complete research or engineering result

  • First-author positioning by default where your contribution supports a publication

  • Timely internal review of research intended for submission

  • Support for conference travel if your paper is accepted

  • Opportunities to demonstrate your work and receive credit for product contributions

  • A competitive monthly stipend

  • Visa and travel support for eligible international candidates

  • Housing support for qualifying international interns in Singapore

  • Equipment and resources needed to complete your work

Internship Details

  • Location: Singapore

  • Duration: Three months

  • Working model: Onsite

  • Start dates: First batch starts in October 2026, second batch starts in January 2027

Every breakthrough in trade infrastructure has followed the same pattern: reduce a transaction cost, expand the market. Containerization for goods. SWIFT for money. Stripe for payments. Compliance is one of the last and largest — and the hardest, because trade rules aren't data to be looked up. They're a complex adaptive system with 190+ sovereign jurisdictions, in different languages, changing constantly, reacting to each other.

Sphere built the system that solves it. Our AI (TRAM) ingests global trade law, interprets it, resolves conflicts across jurisdictions, and produces compliance determinations more reliable than human experts. We handle the entire lifecycle — calculation, registration, filing, remittance — at millisecond latency with zero downtime.

  • Backed by a16z and YC. $21M Series A, 30%+ month-over-month growth, customers include ElevenLabs, Replit, Deel, Runway, and Lovable.

  • Small team, global surface area. Everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. San Francisco, five days in office.

Sphere is looking for a Sales Development Representative to help build our outbound sales engine.

You'll work directly with our Account Executives and Founder to identify the companies we should be selling to, understand why Sphere matters to them, and create opportunities with CFOs, Controllers, Tax leaders, and other senior finance executives.

This isn't a role where you'll inherit a finished playbook and spend your day running someone else's sequences. You'll be expected to prospect relentlessly, learn quickly, experiment with what works, and help us build the playbook as we go.

This role is designed to be a path into an Account Executive position at Sphere. You'll get exposure to the full sales cycle from day one, learn directly from our AEs and the founder, and take on more responsibility as you prove you're ready. We want to develop our next generation of AEs from within.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Build and own targeted account lists across our core markets.

  • Prospect into CFOs, Controllers, Heads of Tax, and other senior finance leaders.

  • Research companies to understand their business model, global footprint, and why Sphere could matter to them.

  • Create pipeline through phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and creative outbound.

  • Work directly with AEs on account strategy, messaging, and multithreading.

  • Learn how to qualify real business problems rather than simply book meetings.

  • Get exposure to discovery, demos, deal strategy, negotiation, and closing.

  • Take on increasing ownership of opportunities as you develop.

  • Experiment constantly with messaging, targeting, signals, and new ways to create pipeline.

  • Help build the outbound playbook that future SDRs at Sphere will inherit.

 

REQUIREMENTS

  • You want to build a career in B2B sales and eventually own a number.

  • You're a strong communicator and comfortable starting conversations with people more senior than you.

  • You're competitive, curious, and willing to put in the reps.

  • You learn quickly and actively seek feedback.

  • You're comfortable operating in an environment where the answer isn't always obvious.

  • You take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do.

  • You're excited to work alongside the team in our San Francisco office five days a week.

 

NICE TO HAVES

  • Previous SDR experience is helpful, but not required. We're more interested in trajectory than pedigree.

  • Previous outbound sales or prospecting experience.

  • Experience at an early stage startup.

  • Experience selling or working with Finance, Accounting, or Tax teams.

  • Evidence that you've been exceptional at something competitive, whether that's sales, athletics, academics, entrepreneurship, or something else.

 

WHO YOU ARE

You'll thrive here if:

  • You're a Dog. You've been underestimated, gone through struggle, and never stopped running. You have a chip on your shoulder and enormous drive. You look at Stripe, Deel, and Flexport all punting on compliance and think: good, that means the opportunity is ours. Hunger beats pedigree.

  • Early stage is in your bones. You've built things where there's no playbook and nobody handing you the answer. You define the problem instead of waiting for instructions.

  • You own it end to end. Give you a goal and you figure out your own path. Small team, global surface area — everyone owns a domain that would be a full team at a larger company. No one tells you how.

  • You believe speed and accuracy are both possible. We're building a complex product that requires robustness and 100% uptime, and we have to build at our customers' pace. Move fast. Don't break things. Both.

  • Being in the room is a feature, not a cost. Five days in SF isn't a policy, it's how the work gets done. The speed and density of collaboration we need doesn't survive over video.

 

This won't be a fit if:

  • You need structure handed to you or ambiguity feels draining rather than motivating

  • You want to manage people more than own hard problems (we're a flat, experienced team — everyone builds)

  • You're used to "good enough" shipping (small errors have outsized impact here)

  • Being in the room five days a week feels like a cost instead of a benefit

Circle (NYSE: CRCL) is one of the world’s leading internet financial platform companies, building the foundation of a more open, global economy through digital assets, payment applications, and programmable blockchain infrastructure. Circle’s platform includes the world’s largest regulated stablecoin network anchored by USDC, Circle Payments Network for global money movement, and Arc, an enterprise-grade blockchain designed to become the Economic OS for the internet. Enterprises, financial institutions, and developers use Circle to power trusted, internet-scale financial innovation. Learn more at circle.com.

What you’ll be part of:

Circle is committed to visibility and stability in everything we do. As we grow as an organization, we're expanding into some of the world's strongest jurisdictions. Speed and efficiency are motivators for our success and our employees live by our company values: High Integrity, Future Forward, Multistakeholder, Mindful, and Driven by Excellence. We have built a flexible work environment where new ideas are encouraged and everyone is a stakeholder.

What you’ll be responsible for: 

Reporting to the Global Head of Capital Markets, you are a capital markets specialist to drive USDC adoption across the repo and swap dealer ecosystem. This role will focus on integrating USDC into secured financing, derivatives margining, and dealer balance-sheet workflows, working directly with primary dealers, swap dealers, clearinghouses, and market infrastructure providers.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of market structure, regulation, and product execution.

What you'll work on: 

Dealer & Market Infrastructure Engagement: 

  • Leading technical engagement with swap dealers, primary dealers, FCMs, CCPs, custodians, and tri-party agents.

Regulatory & Risk Alignment: 

  • Partnering with legal, compliance, and risk teams to ensure USDC integrations align with applicable derivatives and market regulations. 

  • Anticipating regulatory and risk concerns from counterparties and help structure use cases that are scalable and defensible.

Internal Leadership & Expertise:

  • Advising senior leadership on where USDC can deliver meaningful capital, liquidity, and operational benefits.

What you’ll bring to Circle: 

Core Requirements:

  • 12+ years of extensive experience in traditional capital markets, with direct exposure to repo markets, swap dealers, derivatives margining, or collateral management. Experience with primary dealers, swap dealers, FCMs, CCPs, custodians, or major market infrastructure providers.

  • Strong understanding of dealer funding models, balance-sheet constraints, and regulatory capital considerations.

Preferred Requirements:

Additional Information:

Starting pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to: relevant experience, skill set, qualifications, and other business and organizational needs. Please note that compensation ranges may differ for candidates in other locations.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status, or any other protected status required by the laws in the locations where we hire. About BEAM

Bridge to Enter Advanced Mathematics (BEAM) creates pathways for students from low-income, low-access backgrounds to become scientists, mathematicians, engineers, and computer scientists.

We provide BEAM students the same access to high-quality preparation in STEM as their more affluent peers, and we invest deeply in our students' success, with programming from middle school through college graduation focused on joyous, exciting, and rigorous mathematics, building vibrant communities, and supporting students in key life transitions such as college admissions and financial aid.

BEAM has grown from a small summer program serving 17 students in the summer of 2011 to a year-round, national program, serving 450+ students at six summer program sites and 600+ students in year-round programming in New York City and Los Angeles this school year. In addition, our BEAM National pilot program now reaches around 1000 elementary-aged students in seven different states, working to create a new nationwide pathway modeled on our local work. We've seen our students' successes first-hand, and it's backed by data: a quasi-experimental study found that students who attended our 7th grade summer program were 1.3X as likely to declare a STEM major as a matched comparison group.

DESCRIPTION OF THE POSITION

The Manager, Summer Math Enrichment leads BEAM’s local LA Program team’s efforts to fully enroll and implement BEAM’s summer math enrichment programs for 6th and 7th grade Los Angeles students. BEAM's summer math enrichment programs are unlike that of most other programs. Focusing on problem solving (and, in particular, students learning to solve novel problems that they haven't been explicitly taught), mathematical reasoning, and how students synthesize ideas into big-picture perspectives unlocks a deeper appreciation for math and a long-term interest in STEM. BEAM Discovery, our day camp for rising 6th graders, serves 100-150 students per site and focuses on building math self-confidence and appreciation. BEAM Summer Away, our residential camp for rising 7th graders, serves 40-50 students per site and has a greater emphasis on rigor and perseverance. Both summer programs seek to build a strong community among staff and students with a common interest in STEM.  

BEAM students often describe their summer with BEAM as a life-changing experience. It is the catalyst for developing self-confidence in math, and inspiring students to pursue a career in a quant-based STEM field long term. As the Manager, you will have the opportunity to impact LA students at the very beginning of their journey with BEAM and set them on a long term path for success. 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Leadership & Staff Management (15%)

  • Lead the LA Summer Math Enrichment team with clear goals, reflection cycles, and collaborative practices
  • Define and delegate clear roles and responsibilities across the LA Summer Programs team that cover all the required tasks for planning and implementing your team’s summer programs
  • Develop and maintain project management and data tracking tools to monitor the ongoing implementation of summer planning tasks and progress toward summer planning goals

Centralized Summer Program Collaboration (20%)

  • Support the design and facilitation of site leadership training and pre-camp training for all summer staff
  • Collaborate with the Central Summer Program team and Human resources in developing a sustainable recruitment strategy for LA summer staff and implement localized initiatives and/or partnerships that contribute to the hiring goals.
  • Support recruitment, interviews, and selection of seasonal summer staff for all summer sites
  • Support the development of program model improvements, including schedules, policies, and camp management resources, that address pain points from previous summers

Local Summer Program Enrollment & Logistics (45%)

  • Plan and lead the team’s school partnership and admissions strategy to fully enroll all summer program locations with eligible, strong-fit LA students
  • Conduct in-person visits to partner schools to support student admissions
  • Manage the student application process, including admission challenges, interview coordination, and financial/merit eligibility
  • Collaborate with central program summer staff to develop localized summer registration packet for families
  • Maintain the systems and processes for efficiently admitting and registering students into summer programs with all required registration documentation completed by week 1 of camp
  • Oversee the admissions of students into BEAM’s programs and that all admissions requirements are met fairly and equitably in accordance with BEAM policies
  • Lead family engagement strategy for maximizing student engagement and retention throughout the admissions season and into the first week of summer programming
  • Secure multi-year site contracts with local schools and state universities to host summer programs; serve as site liaison for ongoing communication and compliance with site admin hosts 
  • Oversee the planning and execution of all local summer program logistics, including, but not limited to, food, supplies, housing, transportation, department of health permits, and field trips
  • Oversee application and distribution of summer TA stipends in partnership with the Advancement team
  • Generate regular progress reports on enrollment, staffing, and logistics milestones

Summer Site Management (15%)

  • Lead one BEAM summer site each year as a Site Director (with the option of taking every third year off to coach and support all sites) 
  • As a site leader, you will lead a 5-member site leadership team responsible for running the camp. Direct summer responsibilities include: 
    • Oversee the site program leadership team and staff, including conducting evaluations and making rehire decisions.
    • Lead the pre-camp training days in collaboration with other members of the site leadership team.
    • Fine tune training materials and if needed create new materials for pre-camp training days in response to local site needs.
    • Making camp-wide policy adjustments and schedule changes, in consultation with leadership team, host site admins, and input from staff and local Director to address ongoing camp challenges
    • Deciding if a staff member or student requires disciplinary action and/or must be dismissed from camp due to a violation in codes of conduct, in consultation with their guidance counselor, BEAM HQ and the local Director 
    • Delegating new, unassigned, or overflow tasks as needed across the leadership team, faculty, or staff
    • Working with the guidance counselor and DoSL to develop behavior support plans for struggling students identified via the CARE Report. 
    • Engaging with families about their child’s needs, concerns, accommodations, etc. 
    • Ensure camp is running on budget and report progress with the finance team and the local Director.
    • Lead end of camp discussion for your site to collect feedback to inform recommendations for strategic improvements to the program, and complete other program wrap-up tasks.

STEM Enrichment and College Access Support (10%)

  • Collaborate with the STEM Enrichment and Access team in creating a smooth transition between BEAM Summer Away camp and Saturday Program to foster a high engagement from 8th grade students.
  • Support the local STEM Enrichment and Access team with facilitating high school admissions workshops and/or student advising as needed for 8th graders
  • Support the STEM Enrichment and Access team with chaperoning and/or logistics support on field trips, special events, or Saturday STEM exploration classes at predetermined times of year 

QUALIFICATIONS

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional work experience 
  • 2+ years working in summer camp leadership or school leadership
  • Experience designing strong STEM or academics-based programs and curriculum
  • At least 2 years managing a team or a program requiring management of personnel
  • Coaching experience, preferably in a teaching or school environment
  • Professional experience working with low-income communities
  • A strong connection to the “why” of our work for both you and the team you will lead
  • Highly skilled project manager, with a track record of owning a project from start to finish and keeping a team accountable along the way

Preferences:

  • Prior experience working at BEAM Discovery or BEAM Summer Away within a leadership capacity
  • Experience with STEM education, STEM research, or STEM outreach
  • Experience working middle school age students
  • Experience using Asana or other PM tools to manage complex projects
  • A strong math teaching and/or math curriculum background
  • Degrees (bachelor's, master's, or PhD) in a STEM field
  • Fluency in Spanish or Korean
  • Experience in the geographic area served by BEAM (LA/NY)
  • Experience improving operational efficiency
  • Builds team culture through trusting relationships and strong collaboration norms
  • Communicates clearly and effectively, with care and respect for multiple perspectives

Professional Strengths

  • Highly skilled project manager
  • Data-driven planner focused on goals and prioritizing the work that drives impact  
  • Organized and detail-oriented in both planning and implementation of programs 
  • Committed to ongoing data analysis, reflection, and continuous improvement 
  • Enjoys building team culture, trusting relationships, and collaboration norms
  • Communicates clearly and effectively with care and respect for multiple perspectives
  • Solutions-oriented problem solver who can quickly identify and address challenges

PHYSICAL DEMANDS 

This is a hybrid position requiring a combination of on-site work in our Los Angeles office (3 days per week) and remote work from a home workspace. To perform the essential duties of this role, you should expect the following:

  • Work Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 am–5:30 pm (flexible)
  • Digital Work: The role involves extended periods of sitting and regular use of a computer (typing and viewing a screen) and other standard office equipment and technology.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Frequent communication with colleagues and stakeholders through a combination of in-person meetings, video calls, phone, email, and messaging platforms.
  • On-Site Presence: Ability to commute to and work from the LA office on scheduled in-office days, including participation in meetings and collaborative sessions.
  • Physical Environment: Work is performed primarily in an indoor office setting with a low-noise environment. Occasional overhead reaching and limited exposure to outdoor weather conditions may occur when traveling between locations or entering and exiting the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role.

APPLICATION PROCESS

Our process, as described below, has approximately four stages and we anticipate the process lasting about 4-6 weeks in total with someone starting in the role as soon as possible, although we are flexible with the specific date. 

The initial step is to submit your application, including resumé and responses to a few short application questions, via our online portal. When your application is complete, we will follow up with next steps.

Next steps in our process will include a short 30-minute phone interview and/or sample projects so we can get to know you and you can show us your work. We believe in the importance of demonstrated ability and providing opportunities that allow candidates to demonstrate relevant skills for the role throughout our process. The final step of our process is a final interview with the team. 

We will review applications on a rolling basis until the position is filled.

SALARY, BENEFITS, AND OTHER DETAILS

The salary range for this position is $66,000 - $78,375. This is a good faith anticipated range of the job, but the actual pay will be based on any applicant’s skill and experience. 

BEAM provides a number of benefits including:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Health, dental and vision benefits including health plan options that are free for individuals
  • 12 paid holidays including an office closure between Christmas Day and New Year’s Day
  • 15 days of paid annual leave to start, and will increase by one day for each year worked for your first 5 years of employment
  • Paid sick leave
  • 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer match of 50% of elective deferrals, up to 3% of eligible compensation
  • Student loan reimbursement
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits
  • $1,500 annual allowance for professional development

COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

Beyond a commitment to nondiscrimination, we are committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY 

BEAM is an equal opportunity employer and does not unlawfully discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on the basis of an individual’s race (including traits historically associated with race (including, but not limited to, hair texture and protected hairstyles, such as braids, locks and twists), ethnicity, religion (including clothing or facial hair worn in accordance with the religious tenets), color, sex, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, breastfeeding, gender (including actual or perceived sex, gender identity, and gender expression including a person’s actual or perceived gender-related self-image, appearance, behavior, expression, or other gender-related characteristic, regardless of the sex assigned to that person at birth), sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, national origin, immigration or citizenship status, status as a veteran, active military service member, or uniform service member, marital or partnership status, familial status, caregiver status, age (18 or older), predisposing genetic characteristics, disability, creed, status as a victim of domestic violence, sexual violence or stalking, unemployment status, salary history, credit history, an individual’s status as having a known relationship or association with a member or members of a protected category, or any other protected status in accordance with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. This policy applies to all terms, conditions, and privileges of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, compensation, promotion, discipline, and termination. 

All personnel decisions will be made in accordance with the principles of equal employment opportunity and subject only to valid (job-related) requirements for employment, benefits, or promotional opportunities.
descriptions.job-1d42eph:
About Matter Labs

Matter Labs builds private settlement infrastructure that lets regulated institutions settle directly with each other without exposing data, ceding control, or waiting days. Global finance moves $4 quadrillion a year on systems designed for paper and telex. The institutions that built them - from clearing houses to exchanges to the world's largest banks, institutions are now actively replacing them. We're building what comes next.

Our core product, Prividium, gives each institution its own private settlement environment (a Prividium Zone) with independent governance and built-in interoperability across counterparties, asset classes, and jurisdictions. Settlement happens through zero-knowledge proofs: one party proves a transaction is valid without revealing any underlying data to the counterparty. The only private settlement infrastructure built on zero-knowledge cryptography.

Founded in 2018. Backed by a16z and Union Square Ventures. A fully remote team of around 90 with eight years of production zero-knowledge infrastructure behind us, now pointed at the biggest problem in institutional finance.

 

The role

You will build Prividium's business across the UK and European financial-markets ecosystem, based in London. The relationships you develop and the strategic agreements you close will determine how fast this region becomes a core market for us. The role owns territory strategy, pipeline creation, deal execution, and closed agreements with banks, asset managers, exchanges, financial market infrastructures, payment firms, and regulated fintechs. It is a hands-on individual contributor role with full-cycle ownership.

What you'll do

  • Own territory revenue. Deliver agreed pipeline, bookings, and revenue outcomes across the UK and European financial-markets territory.

  • Build the market plan. Develop a clear view of where Prividium wins in the region: priority institutions, use cases, buying groups, and ecosystem partners.

  • Create pipeline. Originate opportunities through executive relationships, direct prospecting, industry events, and partners. Build momentum beyond inbound demand.

  • Run deep discovery. Understand customer workflows, constraints, and economics across tokenised deposits, payments, settlement, collateral, funds, and asset issuance.

  • Navigate institutional buying. Coordinate long processes spanning business leadership, product, technology, architecture, security, risk, compliance, procurement, and legal.

  • Lead evaluations. Work with Solutions Engineering and Product to shape workshops, technical evaluations, and proof-of-concept plans that advance a buying decision.

  • Close strategic agreements. Build mutual action plans, keep deal discipline, and lead commercial and contractual negotiation through to signature.

What we look for

Each of these is a demonstrated capability, shown through work you have done:

  • 8+ years of enterprise B2B sales or strategic-account work, with closed six- or seven-figure agreements.

  • Selling software, data, SaaS, or infrastructure into banks, capital-markets firms, exchanges, FMIs, payment providers, or comparable regulated institutions.

  • Credible relationships and market knowledge across London's institutional finance ecosystem, reaching both business and technology decision-makers.

  • Originating pipeline through insight-led outreach and executive relationships, with named examples of accounts you opened.

  • Leading multi-stakeholder buying processes across security, risk, compliance, procurement, legal, and executive approval.

  • Discussing enterprise architecture, APIs, integration, deployment models, and data privacy credibly with senior technology stakeholders.

If you meet most of these and believe you can do this job, apply anyway.

Nice to have

Working knowledge of blockchain, tokenisation, or institutional digital assets, and experience selling a category-defining product while the sales motion was still being refined. Proven institutional-sales performance matters more.

Work model & pay

  • Competitive base salary

  • Performance-based variable compensation and a long-term token incentive are additional. Both are paid in ZK tokens. New-hire token grants vest over four years with a one-year cliff.

  • Freedom & ownership culture: no time tracking, minimum bureaucracy-only results matter.

About Coinflow

Coinflow is the next-generation payment service provider revolutionizing global financial infrastructure with stablecoins, AI-driven fraud prevention, and instant settlement. Coinflow enables businesses to grow faster with instant settlement, fraud & chargeback indemnity, global pay-ins, multi-currency FX, and unified payouts. Founded in 2023, the company serves marketplaces, fintechs, remittance providers, gaming platforms, and ecommerce merchants worldwide.

Since our seed round in 2024, we’ve achieved 23x revenue growth and scaled to multi-billion-dollar annual transaction volume. In response to this growth, Coinflow announced a $25M Series A in October 2025—led by Pantera Capital, CMT Digital, Coinbase Ventures, Jump Crypto, and Reciprocal Ventures—accelerating our mission to power the world’s fastest-moving businesses with innovative, reliable global payments.

Coinflow is proudly headquartered in Chicago, IL. Learn more at coinflow.cash.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Product Manager to own a high-impact surface area across our risk and compliance infrastructure — and grow into a generalist across the broader product org.

This role sits at the center of:

  • Risk and compliance tooling — internal systems used by our compliance, underwriting, and operations teams

  • Fraud and decisioning infrastructure — the systems that protect the platform and merchants at scale

  • Vendor and banking partner onboarding — owning the end-to-end process of procuring and implementing new payment providers, banks, and networks; coordinating requirements across engineering, legal, compliance, and operations to get partners live

You'll work closely with engineering, data, operations, and our compliance team to design and ship tools that make our internal teams faster, our risk decisions smarter, and our platform more defensible.

This is a high-ownership, high-ambiguity role. You'll be expected to operate with limited structure, identify problems before they're handed to you, and drive execution end-to-end.

What You'll Do

  • Own internal tooling for risk and compliance — identify gaps in how our internal teams work, and build systems that make them faster and more accurate

  • Drive process clarity through product — translate ambiguous, manual workflows into structured, scalable tools

  • Build risk-adjacent product — case management, onboarding flows, decisioning logic, fraud reporting surfaces

  • Own global payments vendor procurement — research and identify pay-in and payout providers across target markets; run structured evaluations across pricing, coverage, compliance posture, and technical fit; drive MSA and legal review; and own the vendor relationship post-onboarding

  • Work directly with engineering and data — turn complex operational requirements into clear, shippable product

  • Contribute across the product org — as you ramp, take on generalist product work across pay-in, payout, and orchestration beyond the risk surface

  • Drive decisions with data — analyze performance, surface insights, and iterate quickly

About You

  • Extremely high bias for action — you move fast, default to building, and unblock yourself

  • Operationally fluent — you can sit with a compliance analyst or underwriter, understand their workflow in depth, and translate that into product requirements

  • Very detail-oriented — you think through edge cases, failure modes, and the messy realities of how internal teams actually work

  • Obsessed over customer experience — You are obsessed with customer experience and want to deliver world class UI/UX internally or externally

  • Deeply data-driven — you rely on metrics, not intuition, to make decisions

  • Genuinely interested in payments and risk — you want to work on hard, high-stakes problems

  • Commercially and operationally fluent across payments rails — you understand how different pay-in and payout providers work, what makes one better than another in a given market, and how vendor selection affects pricing, compliance exposure, and product capability

  • Builder mindset — you take real ownership and treat the product like it's yours

Nice to Have

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure

  • Experience building internal tooling or operational products

  • Experience in global payments vendor procurement or partnerships

  • Exposure to compliance, fraud, underwriting, or risk workflows

  • Experience working with data or ML-driven products

What You Need

  • 4+ years of product management experience

  • Track record of shipping end-to-end — from ambiguous problem to production

  • Comfortable owning a problem space without a roadmap handed to you

  • Strong communication skills and ability to work across technical and non-technical stakeholders

Why Coinflow

  • Work on systems that matter — internal tools that power how real risk decisions get made

  • Direct exposure to payments infrastructure, compliance, and fraud at scale

  • Small, high-caliber team where you'll have real ownership from day one

  • Fast execution environment — what you ship will be in production quickly

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 USD. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, including but not limited to experience, education, skills, qualifications and business needs.

In addition, the employee who fills this role will be eligible for an equity grant, allowing you to share in the long-term success of the company. You will also have access to a wide array of benefits, including health and wellness benefits, 401(k) savings plan, and flexible time off.

Join the team rewriting how money moves worldwide—and become a driving force in the $194 trillion cross-border payments market.
descriptions.job-16e4kmt:
ABOUT HUT 8

Imagine the ultimate destination for those who want to work at the cutting edge of technology, energy, and infrastructure. Hut 8 is on a mission to build and operate some of the world’s largest data centers for next-generation computing workloads, including AI, Colocation, Cloud, and Bitcoin Mining. We are proud to offer interesting and challenging opportunities for individuals who want to build teams, solve problems, and make an impact from day one. If you’re an ambitious individual looking for a career that is as rewarding as it is challenging, you’ve come to the right place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Superintendent, CSA leads civil, structural, and architectural field execution for a new data center build - owning day-to-day site operations for this scope in a high-stakes, mission-critical environment. Reporting to the Construction Manager and Director, Construction, this role drives schedule, coordinates trades, and enforces safety and quality from mobilization through turnover. Superintendents are the standard on a Hut 8 site: what you walk past, you approve.

Some of the key responsibilities you should expect are the following:

Civil & Sitework

Supervise mass grading, excavation, underground utilities, stormwater systems, roadways, and site improvements. Coordinate survey control, earthwork QA/QC (compaction testing, proof rolls, subgrade acceptance), and dewatering operations. Sequence sitework deliberately to release foundations and vertical construction on schedule.

Structural & Foundations

Supervise deep and shallow foundations, structural concrete, tilt-wall or precast erection, and structural steel. Manage concrete placement plans, rebar and embed inspections, anchor bolt survey verification, and structural QC hold points with third-party special inspectors - embeds and anchor bolts placed wrong are the most expensive small mistakes on the job.

Architectural & Envelope

Drive building envelope, roofing, exterior skin, doors and hardware, and interior architectural finishes. Own the water-tightness milestones that gate MEP rough-in and equipment set, and run finish and punch phases with discipline.

Look-Ahead Planning & Trade Coordination

Own the three-week look-ahead for CSA scopes: constraint identification, manpower loading review, and daily coordination with CSA subcontractors. Feed accurate progress to the Planner/Scheduler and escalate slippage with a recovery proposal, not just a report.

Safety & Quality Enforcement

Enforce the site safety program for CSA work - excavation protection, crane and rigging operations, work at height, and concrete operations. Verify installed work against IFC drawings and specs, and hold trade partners to first-time quality.

Documentation & Issue Management

Maintain daily reports, progress quantities, and photo documentation. Drive CSA RFIs and field issues to resolution with the Project Engineer (CSA) and the Civil/Structural Engineers, and capture as-built conditions as the work goes in.

ABOUT YOU

-      What we're looking for:

  • 7+ years of field supervision on heavy civil, structural concrete, or large industrial/commercial building projects; data center, semiconductor, or mission-critical experience strongly preferred.
  • Deep knowledge of earthwork operations, foundation systems, concrete placement, tilt-wall/precast erection, and structural steel - including QA/QC and special inspection requirements.
  • Proven ability to sequence sitework and vertical construction to protect downstream MEP and equipment-set milestones.
  • Strong command of three-week look-ahead planning, manpower review, and subcontractor coordination.
  • Safety leadership on high-risk CSA work: excavation, cranes, and work at height; OSHA 30 preferred.
  • Quality discipline on embeds, anchor bolts, and tolerances - the details that decide whether steel and equipment land.
  • Comfortable with construction management platforms (Procore, ACC, or similar) and full CSA drawing packages.
  • Clear daily reporting and documentation habits.

ABOUT THE WORK ENVIRONMENT

Full-time site-based role.

WHAT MAKES HUT 8 A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

Hut 8 offers a benefits and wellness program that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and short-term and long-term disability insurance, as well as paid time off. We are proud to invest in building the best team in the industry. At all levels of the organization, we are driven by an entrepreneurial spirit, radical transparency, and relentless growth mentality.

At Hut 8, you will have the opportunity to:

▶ Work with bright, driven peers from a range of educational and professional backgrounds including software development, energy, engineering, entrepreneurship, investment banking, private equity, and management consulting

▶ Design and pitch new products, services, and other initiatives to a leadership team consisting of serial entrepreneurs and seasoned executives and backed by a board of directors consisting of industry veterans of energy, finance, and government

▶ Debate ideas and alternatives in a truly meritocratic setting where the learning curve is steep and the lessons come from both senior and junior members of the team

▶ Build a lifelong network of friends and professional connections at the cutting-edge intersection of technology, energy, and infrastructure

What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

As the FP&A Lead at Kalshi, you'll build and own the financial planning and analysis function as we scale. You'll be the person who turns the numbers into a clear story - helping leadership understand where the business stands, where it's headed, and what decisions will get us there faster. You'll build the models, own the forecast, and partner directly with leadership across the company to drive smarter, faster decision-making.

What You'll Do

  • Own company-wide financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting, including revenue, headcount, and operating expense models

  • Build and maintain financial models that reflect the realities of a fast-growing, fast-moving business

  • Partner directly with the executive team and department leads to translate financial analysis into clear, actionable recommendations

  • Lead the monthly and quarterly close-to-reporting cycle, including variance analysis and performance reporting against budget and forecast

  • Develop dashboards and reporting tools that give leadership real-time visibility into the health of the business

  • Analyze new initiatives, pricing decisions, and growth opportunities to inform strategic and operational decisions

  • Support fundraising, board reporting, and investor relations with clear, well-organized financial materials

  • Identify opportunities to improve financial processes, systems, and reporting infrastructure as the company scales

  • Manage and mentor other members of the finance team as the function grows

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, investment banking, or a related field, with meaningful FP&A ownership

  • Strong financial modeling skills and a track record of building models from scratch that hold up as a business scales

  • Excellent analytical skills - able to move from raw data to a clear recommendation quickly

  • Experience partnering directly with senior leadership and communicating financial concepts to non-finance audiences

  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with limited process and a lot of ambiguity

  • Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills; experience with financial planning or BI tools (e.g., Adaptive Insights, Looker, Tableau) is a plus

  • High attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership over accuracy and data integrity

  • Experience managing or mentoring other finance team members is a plus

  • Familiarity with prediction markets, trading, fintech, or crypto is a plus

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $300,000 to $400,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This range reflects current market data for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and broad variance in experience levels within each title; if your compensation expectations exceed this range, we encourage you to reach out - we’re always happy to discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity

descriptions.job-17f6585:
About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket's marketing team is building the creator and UGC engine that introduces millions of people to prediction markets for the first time. This is a Senior Campaign Manager role sitting within that team, reporting to a director, and owning the full lifecycle of influencer and UGC campaigns from initial brief through final performance report. You will work across creative, product, and leadership to get campaigns out the door and make them better each time.

The challenge here is real. Polymarket is a crypto-native, news-driven product that lives and dies by current events. The content that works today may not work next week. You need to move fast, have genuine taste, and know how to brief a creator so they produce something that actually converts, not just something that looks good in a recap deck. This is not a role for someone who needs a lot of direction or who treats campaign analysis as a formality.

This is a backfill, so the infrastructure exists. What we need is someone who can step in, take ownership immediately, and raise the bar on both execution quality and the rigor with which we learn from results.

What You'll Do

  • Own active influencer and UGC campaigns end-to-end, from writing the brief to delivering the final performance report with clear takeaways.

  • Source and manage creator partnerships across relevant verticals, building relationships that produce repeat, high-quality content rather than one-off posts.

  • Brief creators clearly and manage feedback rounds with the internal creative team, keeping timelines tight and quality high.

  • Pull campaign performance data regularly, identify what is working and what is not, and translate those findings into concrete changes for the next campaign.

  • Manage up to directors by proactively communicating campaign status, flagging blockers early, and coming to meetings with answers rather than questions.

  • Navigate cross-functional workflows across product, creative, and leadership without needing hand-holding, keeping campaigns moving even when internal processes are ambiguous.

  • Stay current on content formats, creator trends, and platform shifts so that Polymarket's campaigns reflect what is actually resonating right now, not what worked six months ago.

What We're Looking For

  • 4 to 5 years of experience running influencer and UGC campaigns for tech companies, with work that spans both brand awareness and conversion-focused content.

  • Demonstrated ability to analyze campaign performance data and implement specific, measurable changes to subsequent campaigns based on what you found.

  • Experience managing creator relationships independently, including sourcing, briefing, and holding partners accountable to deliverables and quality standards.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally and managing up, including regular communication with directors and navigating internal workflows that are not always clearly defined.

  • Genuine fluency in online culture and content, you consume it, you understand what is landing right now, and you can apply that instinct to a product tied to real-world events.

  • Strong written communication skills, particularly when it comes to creative briefs and performance summaries that drive decisions rather than just document activity.

  • (Plus) Prior experience working on crypto, web3, or fintech products, or comfort marketing a product that requires some audience education.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Pay Transparency

Base salary range: $125,000 to $150,000, plus equity and benefits.

This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through.

descriptions.job-17df99x:
About Ondo

Capital markets are moving onchain. Ondo Finance is building the products and infrastructure that will bring them there.

We create institutional-grade, blockchain-enabled investment products and services, including tokenized treasuries, tokenized stocks and ETFs, and new trading experiences built for global, always-on markets. We are the category leader by AUM, well-capitalized, and backed by investors including Founders Fund, Coinbase Ventures, Pantera Capital, and Tiger Global.

The underlying financial infrastructure is complex. We believe the product experience should not be.

About the Web team

The Web team builds the product layer that makes Ondo's financial infrastructure accessible. We own the experiences through which users onboard, establish eligibility, move money, mint and redeem Ondo Stocks, manage portfolios, and use products across multiple blockchains.

We are a small team of exceptional engineers with broad ownership and a high bar for craft, judgment, and execution. We turn complexity across compliance systems, backend services, smart contracts, and external partners into products that feel clear and dependable.

Engineering on this team is distinguished by:

  • Product taste. We simplify complex financial workflows without hiding the details that matter.
  • End-to-end ownership. Engineers shape, build, launch, and improve the product.
  • Speed with confidence. We scope sharply, move quickly, and hold a high quality bar.
  • Security and correctness. Access control, auditability, privacy, and failure behavior are design constraints from the start.
  • High agency and low ego. We act without waiting, invite direct critique, and make the team better.

About the role

As a Full-Stack Engineer focused on Growth, you will design the foundations of how users discover, understand, adopt, and return to Ondo's products. You will own the systems and product experiences that turn user insight into measurable growth across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention.

Your scope spans the full growth loop—from public websites and user-facing product journeys to experimentation, analytics, content systems, backend workflows, and third-party platforms. You will set technical direction, define the measurement foundations, and evolve these systems as our products, markets, and scale change.

This is a foundational ownership role for a senior engineer. You will turn ambiguous growth opportunities into clear hypotheses, durable architecture, and polished product experiences. You will partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, Data, and Engineering while owning the judgment: where friction matters, what to build, how to measure it, and when the evidence calls for a different direction.

The goal is not experiment volume. It is to understand users better than anyone else and turn that understanding into durable product improvements and measurable business impact.

What you'll do

  • Own the growth engineering strategy across discovery, acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention—from identifying the highest-leverage opportunities through technical design, launch, measurement, and iteration.
  • Design and evolve the foundations for experimentation, event instrumentation, attribution, funnel analysis, content, and lifecycle experiences so the team can move quickly and trust what it learns.
  • Build polished user-facing experiences and the backend systems, data models, APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations behind them.
  • Work directly with users and product data to identify friction, form clear hypotheses, and make disciplined product and technical bets.
  • Turn validated learning into durable product capabilities and measurable business impact—not one-off experiments.
  • Partner with Product, Design, Marketing, and Data to lead launches, localization, and new ways to grow adoption across Ondo's products.
  • Improve organic discovery and conversion through technical SEO and AEO, performance, structured content, and clear user journeys.
  • Raise the level of the team through clear writing, thoughtful code review, strong operational ownership, and effective use of modern AI engineering tools.

What you bring

  • 4+ years of experience building and operating production full-stack applications with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
  • Experience driving measurable acquisition, activation, engagement, or retention outcomes through growth engineering, product-led growth, consumer product, ecommerce, or similarly data-informed product work.
  • Experience building and operating serverless systems on AWS, including Lambda and adjacent services such as API Gateway, EventBridge, or SQS.
  • Strong experience using BigQuery and product analytics data to model funnels, investigate user behavior, and measure product and business impact.
  • Strong fundamentals in API and data-model design, relational databases, event-driven systems, event instrumentation, experimentation, testing, and observability.
  • A record of owning product work end to end—not only implementing experiments or specifications handed to you.
  • Product taste: you can find the simplest experience that solves the user's problem without ignoring the complexity or edge cases underneath it.
  • Data fluency and intellectual honesty. You can define useful metrics, distinguish signal from noise, and change direction when the evidence challenges your hypothesis.
  • The ability to communicate clearly, learn unfamiliar domains quickly, and create alignment across engineering, product, design, marketing, and data partners.
  • High agency and low ego. You move important work forward, invite strong critique, and care more about the outcome than whose idea wins.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building fintech, trading, crypto-native, or other high-consideration products where earning user trust is essential.
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing, CRM, CMS, experimentation, localization, or analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with AEO, structured content, international SEO, and growth across multiple regions or languages.
  • Experience applying AI to prototyping, personalization, analytics, content operations, or other growth workflows.

We do not expect every strong candidate to arrive with deep crypto or every growth specialty listed above. We do expect curiosity, strong product and engineering fundamentals, and the ability to turn learning into shipped improvements quickly.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work helping define how a global audience discovers and adopts a new category of financial products.
  • Competitive compensation including salary, future token rights, and/or equity, according to your preferences.
  • Full medical, vision, and dental benefits, plus a flexible vacation policy.
  • A remote-first environment with meaningful autonomy and influence over product and technical direction.
  • Exceptional colleagues from Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, Two Sigma, Bridgewater, SpaceX, AWS, Meta, Google, McKinsey, Coinbase, Circle, and Uniswap.
  • Backing from leading crypto experts and investors, including Pantera Capital, Founders Fund, and Coinbase Ventures.

descriptions.job-1hz3omt:
About Ondo

Ondo Finance is building institutional-grade financial infrastructure for tokenized real-world assets. We operate at the intersection of traditional finance and on-chain systems, which means our product surface has to hold up against both the ordinary threats that hit any high-value fintech and the specific ones that follow value on-chain.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Security Engineer - Product Security to own how we ship secure products at Ondo. You will be a security partner for our product engineering teams, driving threat modeling, owning secure code reviews for new products or feature expansions, maintaining and tuning AppSec tooling, and improving the existing SSDLC. You can expect to take ownership of the bug bounty program, new feature to existing product reviews, and similar broad ownership of critical functions paired to a dedicated ProdSec lead. An AI-native approach is welcome, paired with AI-driven approaches should expect to be justified by describing how doing so enables risk outcomes.

This is a hands-on IC role. You will read code, run threat models, review architecture proposals, own tooling, and push engineering teams to build products that are secure by default. You partner closely with adjacent security function like AppSec, Infrasec, and SecOps.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive threat modeling for new features, integrations, and architectural changes across the product surface. Push threat models past templates into decisions that engineering teams actually implement.
  • Own secure code review for high-risk changes — authentication, session management, cryptographic paths, wallet and signing flows, RPC and third-party integrations, permission and consent surfaces.
  • Expand the AppSec tooling stack and treat “reducing false positives” as a first-class deliverable. AI-native integrations are welcome.
  • Design and evolve our secure SDLC: where security fits in the dev workflow, what triggers a review, what a lightweight security sign-off looks like versus a full one, and how do we validate controls.
  • Run our responsible disclosure and bug bounty program. Set scope, triage inbound reports, decide payouts, and drive findings to closure with engineering.
  • Support and own appropriate scope for the intake and closure of findings from external audits and pentests — coordinate with audit vendors (Coinspect, Cantina, NCC Group, and others), organize findings into our internal risk register, and drive remediation with engineering owners.
  • Partner with engineering leads to align o secure-by-default patterns - libraries, templates, sensible defaults, and paved-road implementations of anything security-relevant.
  • Threat model blockchain-integrated components like wallet flows, RPC integrations, signing infrastructure, on-chain admin actions triggered from off-chain systems in partnership with engineers who own the on-chain code.
  • Contribute to hiring, mentoring, and pushing the technical bar on the Security team.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years in Product Security or Application Security, including senior IC time at a fast-moving product company.
  • Deep secure code review skills in at least one modern stack (TypeScript / JavaScript, Python, or Go). Ability to move across stacks at the level required to threat model.
  • Strong threat modeling skills, appropriate to experience - you can drive a real threat model with an engineering team, not just fill in a template. In practice, we look for core understanding of industry-relevant TTPs and IoCs and strong intuitions on how to apply those lessons learned to our products.
  • Practical experience owning or majorly contributing to an AppSec tooling program. You have shipped rules, tuned noise, and measured impact.
  • Comfortable running or building a bug bounty / responsible disclosure program end-to-end assuming properly resourced to do so.
  • Strong working knowledge of modern web and API security - session and auth flows, OAuth and OIDC, browser security model, common web/API vulnerability classes, and their less-common variants.
  • Comfortable reading Terraform, cloud IAM policies, and CI/CD configuration well enough to reason about how a product vulnerability crosses into an infra risk.
  • Strong engineering partnership skills - you engage constructively, understand the “why” before proposing risk controls, you know when to accept risk, and you write things down.
  • Willing to grow into blockchain-adjacent product security on the job, including the specific attack surface introduced by wallet, signing, and on-chain-integration code.

Blockchain Exposure Note

  • This role firmly lives in Web2 prodsec. But, it also requires someone who understands what “Web2 vs Web3” terminology means. In other words, how our products interact with blockchains creates unique threat models that all product security teammates must grasp. At a minimum, by Day 1 you should have strong intuitions about how blockchains will make your prodsec experience unique, you should grasp the common terminologies, and you should be able to discuss with colleagues several incident post-mortems that demonstrate how Web2 compromises lead to Web3 funds losses.
  • You do not need to be an expert in smart contract auditing, blockchain security architectures, or decentralized consensus-driven risk controls.

Nice to Have

  • Prior work at a crypto, fintech, or other company where products handle high-value or irreversible actions.
  • Familiarity with wallet, signing, or key-management flows.
  • Reading-level familiarity with Solidity or Rust, target: when ProdSec intersects with smart contracts or other on-chain applications, you can parse what the code is likely doing, and work with blockchain security subject matter experts from there.
  • Bug bounty history - reports, CVEs, or published write-ups.
  • Familiarity with browser-extension security, mobile app security, or account-abstraction wallet designs.
  • Public output - talks, blog posts, open-source tools, CVEs.

How We Work

The Security team values a high trust team environment where respectful candor can thrive. We expect senior engineers to have an opinionated take on how to accomplish a task, accept feedback from the team and other external stakeholders and return it in kind, and to always assume positive intent. Professionalism, ethics, and enabling stakeholders towards common goals are important always.

Galaxy Digital Inc. (Nasdaq: GLXY) is a global leader in digital assets and data center infrastructure, growing the economy that runs on code. Galaxy delivers the onchain infrastructure that connects institutions to digital assets, including trading, advisory, asset management, staking, self-custody, and tokenization. The Company is headquartered in New York City, with offices across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.
